slots.notes: Fullscreen looping precision-farming hero background video sitting behind the dark hero headline/nav (cover-cropped, muted autoplay). The captured corpus only retained its poster + animated-gif preview (hero-acreage-farming-poster.png / hero-acreage-farming-preview.gif), not the source mp4, so the actual clip must be supplied; reskin with a brand drone/field/aerial farmland loop and keep a matching poster frame as the loading fallback.

Photographic content imagery for the light sections / service cards (reference repo files 0098888.jpg, 1.jpg, 02604201313.png). Real-world farmland/crop/equipment photos used as cover-cropped card or band backgrounds rather than transparent cut-outs. Supply 3 brand photos; one (02604201313.png) is reused in multiple places in the reference, so a single hero/feature shot can repeat if the brand pool is thin.

Three Lottie (bodymovin JSON) micro-animations used as animated illustrations across the stats grid / service cards (reference assets tractor.json, beetle.json, curry.json -> farming machinery, pest/crop, and produce motifs). Loaded as lottie animation data, transparent over their tiles. Replace with brand-themed Lottie files; if the brand has none, substitute looping transparent webm/svg-animation per tile and note the player swap.

Positive/negative state glyphs for the service / comparison rows: a tick-circle (included / yes) and a close-circle (excluded / no), supplied as standalone transparent SVG files (reference tick-circle.svg, close-circle.svg) rather than inline lucide glyphs. Their stroke/fill color is baked into the SVG file, so retinting to the brand accent/error pair means editing the asset (or re-authoring them as currentColor-driven icons).

Five horizontally-scrolling partner/customer logos in the logo marquee, supplied as ~150px-wide transparent SVG wordmarks (reference assets voiceflow / zendesk / pendo / glide / canva -logo-svg-150px.svg). Each is a flat single-color vector typically desaturated/dimmed to a muted foreground tint on the marquee strip. Replace with the brand's real partner/client logos; preserve the marquee loop and keep them transparent so they sit on either the dark or light band.

mechanic: Scrolling precision-farming landing hero that transitions from a dark video-backed headline section into light content bands, layering a numeric stats grid, an infinitely looping partner-logo marquee, and Lottie-animated service cards with tick/close state icons.
techDelivery: Authored as a bolt.new / GitHub React landing-page project (boltUrl bolt.new/~/github-pzt1ayyk) whose assets are pulled from the external GitHub repo dsMagnatov/Acreage-landing-assets (raw.githubusercontent jpg/png photos, *.svg logos + state icons, *.json Lottie); exact bundler/CSS/font stack is not in the exported corpus and must be read from that source repo.
reskinNotes: CRITICAL: the exported MotionSites prompt for this template captured ONLY the one-line summary ('Precision farming landing page with dark/light sections, hero video background, stats grid, logo marquee, and service cards'), not the inline font-family, hex/CSS, or motion-value declarations the other interfaces have. fontRoles and colorRoles are therefore left empty rather than fabricated; the native typeface(s) and the dark/light palette (bg/surface/fg/fgMuted/accent/accent2/border) MUST be recovered from the bolt.new GitHub source (github-pzt1ayyk) before this template is safe to reskin, since the palette/type math depends on accurate native values. The sections list is reconstructed from the summary's named regions, and the slot inventory is recovered from prompt-embedded-urls (the dsMagnatov/Acreage-landing-assets repo), per the spec's 'recoverable from prompt text + prompt-embedded-urls' rule. The tick/close state icons and the five partner-logo SVGs carry their colors baked into the SVG files (not CSS vars), so retinting requires asset edits; the hero source video itself was not retained (only poster + gif), so a brand clip must be sourced anew.
